description: This source file implements the ComponentContainer class, which is responsible for loading and initializing components within the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles loading component configurations from directories, load files, and ensures dependencies are sorted. It also maintains the loaded state and provides startup and initialization logic for the container.

classes.name: ComponentContainer
classes.description: A container class responsible for loading and managing components in the OFBiz framework. Manages component initialization, dependency sorting, and loading configurations from directories and load files.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the container with command list, container name, and configuration file path.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Loads components from the specified OFBiz home directory, throwing exception if already loaded.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Returns true if the container has been successfully loaded.

methods.name: loadComponent
methods.description: Loads a component based on its definition, either a directory or a single component.

methods.name: loadComponentDirectory
methods.description: Loads all components within a directory, delegating to load using a load file if present.

methods.name: loadComponentsInDirectoryUsingLoadFile
methods.description: Loads components specified in a load XML configuration file within a directory.

methods.name: loadComponentsInDirectory
methods.description: Loads all components in a directory without a load file, sorted alphabetically.

methods.name: retrieveComponentConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the component configuration from a given directory path.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Placeholder method to stop the container; currently does nothing.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the container.
